'''Merr-Sonn''' was a group of three [[MB-C1 medium transport]]s that were presumably belonging to [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] That was present at'' [[Calast]]'', a [[Golan Space Colony 2]] space station during the [[Rescue at Bundil II]]. The ship contained [[Plant|Herbs]].
